source.title: WoW historical patch notes / disenchanting mechanics

quote: There is now a minimum required skill level on all disenchantable items.
notes: Patch-era general skill-eligibility change, not a measured yield or per-item Retail gate.
affects: All disenchantable equipment (minimum Enchanting skill gate)
wording: There is now a minimum required skill level on all disenchantable items.

source.title: WoW historical patch notes / disenchanting mechanics

quote: An item with 0 charges will remain, and this item is now unable to be vendored or disenchanted.
notes: State-conditional patch restriction, not unconditional noDisenchant; exact itemID corroborated at https://www.wowhead.com/mop-classic/item=13508/eye-of-arachnida.
affects: Eye of Arachnida (item 13508) ONLY after depletion of all three charges
wording: An item with 0 charges will remain, and this item is now unable to be vendored or disenchanted.

source.title: WoW historical patch notes / disenchanting mechanics

quote: Ogri'la Faction Vendor: All epic and superior quality items are now disenchantable.
notes: Patch applies to a source-defined vendor group, not every reputation item; no per-item IDs inferred and modern eligibility unknown.
affects: Ogri'la Faction Vendor: superior and epic quality rewards (group, individual itemIDs not enumerated)
wording: Ogri'la Faction Vendor: All epic and superior quality items are now disenchantable.

quote: Blue Suede Shoes can now be disenchanted.

quote: Green Woolen Vest is now a of uncommon quality item and can be disenchanted.
notes: Undocumented community-compiled patch change, lower provenance confidence than official notes; itemID corroborated https://www.wowhead.com/wotlk/item=2582/green-woolen-vest.
wording: Green Woolen Vest is now a of uncommon quality item and can be disenchanted.

source.title: WoW historical patch notes / disenchanting mechanics

quote: Gnomish Cloaking Device is now uncommon quality, up from common, and can be disenchanted.
notes: Undocumented historical change; exact itemID https://www.wowhead.com/item=4397/gnomish-cloaking-device. Current Classic Wowhead says cannot be disenchanted; preserve version conflict and do not mark current eligible.
wording: Gnomish Cloaking Device is now uncommon quality, up from common, and can be disenchanted.

source.title: WoW historical patch notes / disenchanting mechanics

quote: Materials received through Disenchant are now based on the item's expansion level instead of item level.
notes: Expansion-wide historical model break. This is not numeric measured evidence for Warmaul Legplates 24995 or proof that 24995 is eligible for live Retail Disenchant.
affects: All Disenchant output-material identity groups: expansion of the input equipment rather than raw item level
wording: Materials received through Disenchant are now based on the item's expansion level instead of item level.
